in_sanskrit.name: कल्पिता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: She who is created or formed, or who manifests something. This name is derived from the root verb कल्प् (kalp) which means to create, form, manifest, or make.

in_hindi.name: कल्पिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: She who has been made or created. This name is derived from the root verb कल्प् (kalp) which means to create, form, manifest, or make.

in_tamil.name: கல்பிதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: She who has crossed the threshold (of creation). This name is derived from the root verb கல் (kal) which means to create, form, or make.

in_telugu.name: కల్పితా
in_telugu.long_meaning: She who has been created or made. This name is derived from the root verb కల్ప్ (kalp) which means to create, form, manifest, or make.

in_marathi.name: Kalpita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalpita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who creates or develops, often used for deities who create the universe or beings.

in_bengali.name: Kalpita
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Creator, Developer
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kalpita একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who creates or develops, often used for deities who create the universe or beings.

vedic_reference.note: The name Kalpita is a popular name in Hindu mythology and appears in various texts such as the Mahabharata and the Puranas. It is believed to be derived from the root verb कल्प् (kalp), which is used extensively in the Vedas to describe the creation of the universe and various other manifestations.
